cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a towering magic library where books drift slowly through the air between tall shelves — reads a glowing spellbook with drifting rune light held open in both hands; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — tilts a round gold-and-silver photo reflector to bounce light onto her face; overgrown jungle temple ruins — sitting on the ground; a neon-lit indoor late-night bowling alley with empty lanes and a glowing ball-return machine — she celebrates an unexpectedly lucky strike with a small satisfied smile while waiting for her ball to return; a sunny seaside boardwalk lined with palms — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a private outdoor saltwater flotation pool with white stone ledges and bright midday reflections — she reclines against a floating cushion and lifts the bottom of her dripping swim cover skirt to drain a little trapped pool water over the ledge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the Changban Bridge memorial — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; the curved black-tiled roof ridge of a great hall under a huge full moon — holds an old thread-bound martial-arts manual with a faded cover against her chest; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — perched on a ledge or edge; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; the splash pool at the foot of tall twisting water slides — carries her keepsake low at her side
